text:
jess: Quick check — are we good to do the lockfile bump + vendor refresh before tomorrow's cutoff? I have a small changelog item that needs to land with the version bump.
arun: I can cut a PR for the submodule pointer update. Will it be a separate PR from the vendor bump or combined? :thinking:
maya: prefer separate if the submodule is just a pointer change. Keeps CI faster and easier to revert if something flakey shows up.
sam: FYI CI is flaky on the vendor job right now (go mod vendor step). If we combine, we might block the whole window. I'm debugging racey cache invalidation.
liam: timeline wise: cutoff is 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Anything touching lockfiles or vendor needs to be merged before 07:30 UTC so we can run the smoke and lockfile-sanity job.
jess: Good call. arun — can you do submodule pointer in one PR, mark for fast-merge? maya will do vendor bump in a follow-up PR?
arun: Yep. I'll open 1 PR updating the submodule ref and add a one-line changelog note. Tagging @maya for the vendor follow-up.
maya: I'll prepare vendor bump PR and include the changelog snippet template. Will run local vendor verification. ETA 3 hours.
sam: Quick note, for vendor bump CI: if you need to force re-run the presubmit, use `/rerun vendortest` in the PR thread — the deploy bot is wired to that.
deploy-bot: presubmit queued for re-run: vendortest — triggered by sam. Status: pending.
olivia: Also nudge product about the changelog line — we need approval for the release notes. If they object, we risk missing the cutoff.
jess: Good — I'll ping product now. Also we should add a rollback plan in each PR description: how to revert the lockfile change, and which tag/branch to roll back to.
arun: For rollback: revert the submodule commit and open a hotfix on the release branch. Will add those instructions.
maya: Vendor PR will include the exact vendor sha and a quick test matrix: linux/amd64 and container smoke.
liam: CI windows — if either PR lands after 07:30 UTC, I'll hold them for post-cutoff batch to avoid destabilizing the release build. Please aim for earlier.
jess: Copy. I'll post ETA updates in this thread. Product pinged (cc @olivia). :thumbsup:
olivia: product acked the changelog wording, one tiny tweak to the phrasing — I've DM'd jess.
jess: Update: submodule PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4281 — @arun please add reviewers.
arun: Added reviewers: maya, liam. Marked for fast-merge if CI green.
maya: Vendor PR draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4282 — running local verification now.
sam: CI infra note: if vendortest fails with "checksum mismatch" try deleting the module cache and re-run. Command:
```
GO111MODULE=on go clean -modcache
```
That fixed it for me earlier.
jess: Thanks. If anything blocks beyond 07:30 UTC, we'll table to post-cutoff and document in release notes. Anyone want the final merge rights when green?
liam: I'll do the final merge for submodule after smoke. maya can merge vendor once the smoke matrix is green.
jess: Awesome. I'll update this thread when merges happen. :rocket:
